# Salvador Ibiza

> Traditional wooden boat trips and private charters departing from San Antonio, Ibiza. All-inclusive day and sunset cruises with open bar, tapas, paddleboards, kayaks and snorkelling.

Salvador Ibiza is a tour operator based in the port of San Antonio, Ibiza (Balearic Islands, Spain). We offer shared day trips (~3 hours), sunset cruises (~3 hours), and private charters for families, couples, groups and corporate events.

## What makes Salvador Ibiza different

- Traditional wooden boat (not a party boat)
- All-inclusive: captain, crew, fuel, open bar, tapas, fresh fruit
- 15 paddleboards, 2 kayaks, snorkelling equipment included
- Family-friendly, relaxed atmosphere
- Departs from San Antonio port
- Routes along Ibiza's west coast (Cala Comte area) and north coast (Es Vedrà, Sa Foradada)
- Rated 4.9/5 from 1600+ Google reviews
